errors.text_span: with the latter two abbreviated for simplicity
errors.evidence: This claim is an incorrect interpretation of the accompanying paper caption and is not verifiable from the image itself. The image shows four model names, and there is no information to suggest only the latter two are abbreviated.

errors.text_span: The chart displays five groups of bars, each corresponding to a different attribute
errors.evidence: The chart displays four groups of bars, one for each model on the x-axis. Each of these four groups contains five bars representing the different attributes.

errors.text_span: The Qwen2.5-7b-1M model shows accuracy values of approximately 90 for all attributes
errors.evidence: This is an over-generalization. The values for this model show visible variation, ranging from approximately 85 (university) to over 90 (major).

errors.text_span: while Internlm3-8b shows values around 70 for all attributes
errors.evidence: This is a significant misrepresentation of the data. The values for this model vary widely, from approximately 55 (university) to nearly 90 (birthdate). 'Around 70' is not an accurate summary.
The range for ProLong-8b is approximately 28 to 84. The stated lower bound of 30 is incorrect, as the 'major' bar is visibly below the 30 mark.
The range for Qwen2.5-7b is approximately 2 to 15. The stated lower bound of 5 is incorrect, as several bars are visibly much lower, around the 2-4 range.
